panels.description: Compaction health from the compactor's /metrics. Backlog pins gen0 files into every query scan, so lag is a query-cost problem before it is a storage problem.
panels.title: InfluxDB 3 — Compaction (Pacha Tree)

panels.description: Age of the oldest snapshot the compactor has not yet merged, per ingest node (influxdb3_compactor_snapshot_lag_seconds, scraped from the compactor's /metrics). Do not alert on this alone: the metric reports 0 for a node that has never compacted, so a brand-new node looks perfect while holding a backlog. Alert on uncompacted snapshots.

targets.query: SELECT max("gauge") AS "lag_s" FROM "influxdb3_compactor_snapshot_lag_seconds" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "node_id" fill(previous)

panels.title: Compaction lag — oldest uncompacted snapshot

panels.description: Snapshots discovered but not compacted, per ingest node. Each one pins its gen0 files into every query's scan set — this is the real cost of lag. Sustained >5 is worth a look; >20 means queries are reading a wide file set.

targets.query: SELECT max("gauge") AS "uncompacted" FROM "influxdb3_compactor_uncompacted_snapshots" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "node_id" fill(previous)

panels.title: Uncompacted snapshots (backlog pinning gen0 into every scan)

panels.description: 1 = this node holds the compactor lease and is scheduling compaction. No node reporting 1 means nothing is compacting; more than one for longer than a lease term means split-brain.

targets.query: SELECT last("gauge") AS "primary" FROM "influxdb3_compactor_is_primary" WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Compactor primary

panels.description: Snapshots that failed to compact and are accumulating. Non-zero is a gate, not just a symptom: --recover-deferred-snapshots only runs while every ingest node has fewer in-flight snapshots than --recover-deferred-snapshots-in-flight-limit (default 3), which a busy cluster never drops below. Raise the limit to 32+ to let recovery drain.

targets.query: SELECT last("gauge") AS "deferred" FROM "influxdb3_compactor_deferred_snapshots" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY "node_id"

panels.title: Deferred snapshots

panels.description: Admission budget (--compactor-input-size-budget, default 50% of RAM) vs bytes in flight. Used pinned at the budget while uncompacted snapshots climb means capacity, not a stall: raise the budget or add a compact node.

targets.query: SELECT max("gauge") AS "used" FROM "influxdb3_compactor_memory_used_bytes" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)
SELECT max("gauge") AS "budget" FROM "influxdb3_compactor_memory_budget_bytes" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)

panels.title: Compactor memory — used vs budget
